runtime_encoding: lossless uint64 PC plus lossless 58-bit cache-line number

neural_action_decoder.request_count: stateless event-keyed Bernoulli inverse-CDF hurdle plus common-quantile Poisson inverse-CDF excess
neural_action_decoder.targets: stateless event-keyed inverse-CDF sample from a mean-canonicalized three-component direct signed cache-line delta mixture

stochastic_decoding: stateless SHA-256 event-keyed inverse-CDF common-random-number sampling
captured_stride_actions_role: normal replay and supervised labels only
training_target: captured Stride request count and direct target addresses as supervision only

lstm.architecture: compact single-layer exact-PC-keyed stateful LSTM plus keyed hurdle/Poisson count and mean-canonicalized direct-delta mixture decoder
lstm.pc_state_memory: dynamic exact-PC map with no fixed tracker capacity
lstm.stateful_training: chronological per-PC TBPTT; hidden/cell values cross batches and graph history is detached at batch boundaries
lstm.inference_history: fresh state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology; only evaluation callbacks are decoded

parameter_counts: measured and asserted exactly; never thresholded
